title: Molecular insights into the dual activation of PomZ, a ParA/MinD P-loop ATPase, by the two ATPase-activating proteins PomX and PomY.
authors: Klos, Philipp; Harms, Andrea; Sogaard-Andersen, Lotte
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold 3结构建模研究细菌PomX/Y/Z系统中两个激活蛋白对PomZ ATPase的双重激活机制，其中PomY含无序区域并介导与PomZ二聚体的互作，虽对象为细菌分裂定位系统而非典型IDP-PPI相分离，但无序区域介导互作机制建模的思路对本课题有启发。
abstract: Positioning of the division site is precisely regulated. In Myxococcus xanthus, the PomX/Y/Z assembly associates with and translocates across the nucleoid in a PomZ ATPase-dependent manner to position the cytokinetic FtsZ ring at midcell. Unlike other systems incorporating a ParA/MinD ATPase, the PomX/Y/Z system incorporates two ATPase-activating proteins (AAPs), PomX and PomY, that stimulate PomZ activity. While PomX AAP activity, similarly to that of other characterized AAPs of ParA/MinD ATPases, resides in a short positively charged N-terminal peptide (PomX(NPEP)), the mechanism of PomY-mediated PomZ activation remained unknown. We map PomY AAP activity to its C-terminal residues 496-682 (PomY(496-682)) and show that this activity is important for division site positioning and the initiation of division. Structural modeling suggests a bipartite PomY(496-682) architecture, comprising a globular domain and an intrinsically disordered region containing the short alpha5 helix. However, this modeling suggests an interaction only between alpha5 and the PomZ dimer. The suggested alpha5 binding site partially overlaps with that of the prototype AAP ParB on the ParA dimer, but alpha5 lacks a positively charged residue critical for ParB AAP activity. Structural modeling suggests that PomX(NPEP) binds the PomZ dimer at a site distinct from that of alpha5 and that overlaps with that of the prototype AAP MinE on the MinD dimer. These findings reveal a non-canonical AAP mechanism of PomY, while PomX(NPEP) likely functions analogously to MinE, indicating that PomX and PomY act in concert through distinct but complementary mechanisms to stimulate PomZ ATPase activity, thereby efficiently driving the positioning of the cytokinetic FtsZ ring.IMPORTANCEIn bacteria, the regulatory systems that position the division site often incorporate a ParA/MinD ATPase. These ATPases also function in the positioning of numerous other macromolecular complexes in bacteria. Characteristically, these ATPases depend on stimulation of their ATPase activity by a single cognate ATPase-activating protein (AAP). However, the Myxococcus xanthus cell division regulatory PomX/Y/Z system stands out by incorporating two AAPs, PomX and PomY, that activate the PomZ ATPase. Similar to other AAPs, PomX uses a short, positively charged N-terminal peptide (PomX(NPEP)) to stimulate PomZ activity. We map PomY AAP activity to a C-terminal region spanning residues 496-682 (PomY(496-682)). Structural modeling using AlphaFold 3 suggests that the AAP activity of PomY(496-682) and PomX(NPEP) may involve two distinct, non-overlapping binding sites at the dimer interface of ATP-bound PomZ. Altogether, these results provide insights into the molecular mechanism of activation by two AAPs of a ParA/MinD ATPase.
abstract_zh:
分裂位点的定位受到精确调控。在黄色粘球菌（Myxococcus xanthus）中，PomX/Y/Z 组装体以 PomZ ATPase 依赖的方式与拟核（nucleoid）结合并跨其转位，从而将细胞分裂的 FtsZ 环定位在细胞中部。与包含 ParA/MinD ATPase 的其他系统不同，PomX/Y/Z 系统包含两个 ATPase 激活蛋白（ATPase-activating proteins, AAPs），即 PomX 和 PomY，它们刺激 PomZ 的活性。虽然 PomX 的 AAP 活性（与其他已表征的 ParA/MinD ATPase 的 AAPs 类似）位于一个短的正电荷 N 端肽段（PomX(NPEP)）中，但 PomY 介导的 PomZ 激活机制此前仍属未知。我们将 PomY 的 AAP 活性定位到其 C 端残基 496-682（PomY(496-682)），并证明该活性对分裂位点定位和分裂起始至关重要。结构建模提示 PomY(496-682) 具有双部分架构，包含一个球状结构域和一个含有短 alpha5 螺旋的内在无序区域。然而，该建模仅提示 alpha5 与 PomZ 二聚体之间存在相互作用。所建议的 alpha5 结合位点与原型 AAP ParB 在 ParA 二聚体上的结合位点部分重叠，但 alpha5 缺乏对 ParB AAP 活性至关重要的正电荷残基。结构建模提示 PomX(NPEP) 在 PomZ 二聚体上的结合位点与 alpha5 的位点不同，且与原型 AAP MinE 在 MinD 二聚体上的结合位点重叠。这些发现揭示了 PomY 的非经典 AAP 机制，而 PomX(NPEP) 可能以类似于 MinE 的方式发挥作用，表明 PomX 和 PomY 通过不同但互补的机制协同作用，刺激 PomZ ATPase 活性，从而高效驱动细胞分裂 FtsZ 环的定位。

重要性在细菌中，负责定位分裂位点的调控系统通常包含一个 ParA/MinD ATPase。这些 ATPase 也参与细菌中许多其他大分子复合物的定位。典型地，这些 ATPase 依赖单一同源 ATPase 激活蛋白（AAP）对其 ATPase 活性的刺激。然而，黄色粘球菌的细胞分裂调控 PomX/Y/Z 系统因包含两个 AAPs（PomX 和 PomY）而显得突出，它们激活 PomZ ATPase。与其他 AAPs 类似，PomX 使用一个短的正电荷 N 端肽段（PomX(NPEP)）来刺激 PomZ 活性。我们将 PomY 的 AAP 活性定位到跨越残基 496-682 的 C 端区域（PomY(496-682)）。使用 AlphaFold 3 的结构建模提示，PomY(496-682) 和 PomX(NPEP) 的 AAP 活性可能涉及 ATP 结合 PomZ 二聚体界面上的两个不同且不重叠的结合位点。总之，这些结果为 ParA/MinD ATPase 的两个 AAPs 激活的分子机制提供了见解。
